privacyPage.subtitle: This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal financial information.
privacyPage.contactSupport: Please contact our security team at: {email}
privacyPage.sec1Desc: We collect information to provide better services to our users. This includes information you provide when creating an account (such as name, email) and the financial transactions you enter into the system for budget planning and analysis.
privacyPage.sec2Desc: Your data is used to analyze spending trends, suggest budgets via the AI assistant, and personalize your financial management experience. We strictly do not sell or share your personal financial data with third parties.
privacyPage.sec3Desc: We implement industry-standard security measures including data transmission encryption (SSL/TLS) and secure database storage. Your password is one-way hashed before storage.
privacyPage.sec4Desc: You have full rights to access, edit, or request the deletion of your account and all stored financial data in the SmartMoney system at any time through the Account Settings or by contacting us directly.

termsPage.subtitle: Please read these Terms of Service carefully before using the SmartMoney platform.
termsPage.sec1Desc: By creating an account or accessing the SmartMoney application, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms of Service and all applicable policies.
termsPage.sec2Desc: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials. You are fully responsible for all activities that occur under your SmartMoney account.
termsPage.sec3Desc: SmartMoney provides personal and group spending management tools. Users must not use the platform for unlawful activities, unauthorized data scraping, or attempting to compromise server security.
termsPage.sec4Desc: We reserve the right to update, modify, or enhance features within SmartMoney to improve system performance, security, and user experience.

helpPage.subtitle: Find answers to frequently asked questions or learn how to use SmartMoney effectively.
helpPage.q1: How do I create a new account?
helpPage.a1: You can click on the "Sign Up" button on the home page, enter your email, username, and password to start using SmartMoney.
helpPage.q2: How do I create a spending budget?
helpPage.a2: Go to the "Budgets" section from the sidebar, and click "Create Budget". You can manually enter budgets for each category or use the "AI Budget Generation" feature to let the system analyze and suggest budgets.
helpPage.a3: All of your transaction data is SSL/TLS encrypted during transmission and securely stored on our servers. We do not share your data with any third party.
helpPage.q4: Can I export report data to Excel?
helpPage.a4: Yes, the system supports exporting your spending reports and transaction list as Excel (.xlsx) files. You can find the Excel export button in the Transactions or Analysis screen.
